translation:
The horizontal cun method: from the inner canthus of the eye to the outer canthus, this is one cun. The horizontal and straight cun methods of the head both follow this. <ins>Chest and abdomen (胸腹部)</ins>
From below the Adam's apple to the middle of the supraclavicular fossa (缺盆), it is four cun long. (This speaks of the depression above the great bone, which is the place of the Tiantu (天突) point.) From below the supraclavicular fossa to the middle of the chest bone (𩩲骭), it is nine cun long.
